mapper.select: SELECT a.acc_id AS id, a.account_number AS accountId, c.name AS holderName, a.balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version, a.updated_at AS lastUpdated FROM accounts a INNER JOIN clients c ON c.acc_id = a.acc_id WHERE a.acc_id = #{accountId}
SELECT c.acc_id AS accountId, c.name AS name, c.email AS email, c.phone AS phone, c.dob AS dob FROM clients c WHERE c.acc_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.acc_id AS accountId, a.balance AS cashBalance, ROUND(COALESCE(held.amount, 0), 2) AS heldForOrders, ROUND(GREATEST(a.balance - COALESCE(held.amount, 0), 0), 2) AS availableToWithdraw, a.base_currency AS currency, a.updated_at AS asOf FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN (
) held ON held.account_id = a.acc_id WHERE a.acc_id = #{accountId}
mapper.sql: SELECT p.account_id AS account_id, SUM(o.quantity * o.price) AS amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = o.portfolio_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'NEW' GROUP BY p.account_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.account_id AS accountId, i.ticker AS symbol, CAST(ph.quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity, ph.avg_cost AS averageCost FROM portfolio_holdings ph INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = ph.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = ph.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY i.ticker ASC

SELECT i.ticker AS symbol, i.name AS name, i.currency AS currency FROM instruments i WHERE i.tradable = TRUE
AND UPPER(i.name) LIKE CONCAT(UPPER(#{prefix}), '%')
ORDER BY i.name ASC, i.ticker ASC

SELECT COALESCE(cp.currency, a.base_currency) AS currency, COALESCE(cp.theme, 'LIGHT') AS theme, COALESCE(cp.alert_channel, 'EMAIL') AS alertChannel FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN customer_preferences cp ON cp.acc_id = a.acc_id WHERE a.acc_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_preferences (acc_id, currency, theme, alert_channel) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{currency}, #{theme}, #{alertChannel}) ON CONFLICT (acc_id) DO UPDATE SET currency = EXCLUDED.currency, theme = EXCLUDED.theme, alert_channel = EXCLUDED.alert_channel
mapper.select: SELECT acc_id, balance, base_currency, status, version FROM accounts WHERE acc_id = #{accountId}
